summary: Soluna Holdings' wholly owned subsidiary acquired the remaining 49% membership interests in Dorothy 1B Project Company from Navitas West Texas Investments SPV for ~$8.8M cash, obtaining 100% ownership. The purchase closed simultaneously with the MIPA signing on May 19, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee are stated. The target is focused on proprietary bitcoin mining. The transaction is a bolt-on acquisition structured as a membership interest purchase. Watch for integration and any future funding needs for the bitcoin mining operations; the risk-arb angle is limited as this is a closed deal.
